info.description: The Meeting Participants Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about participants in scheduled meetings. This endpoint enables organizations to assess participant engagement and communication dynamics for each meeting. Typical consumers include project managers, team leaders, and administrative staff who need to verify attendance or analyze participation trends. The API supports retrieving participant information efficiently, facilitating better planning and decision-making regarding future meetings.

get.description: Fetches a list of participants associated with specific meetings. This endpoint allows users to view all individuals who are part of the scheduled meetings.
